note: Scott County, IN publishes its official zoning map only as a PDF exhibit adopted by reference in the zoning ordinance (Article 4). The county GIS viewer (scottin.wthgis.com) is a parcel map with no ArcGIS REST zoning service found; the county Open Data hub has no Indiana zoning layer (its 'Zoning' FeatureService is Minnesota's Scott County). Scottsburg, Austin and Lexington publish no GIS zoning layer either (Scottsburg's planning page links only PDFs).
